item.title: Think, plan, then implement: How to really stay in the loop
item.description:
It’s 1:00 PM and you are about to head to lunch. You’ve already shipped three or four PRs to your integration branch—the same volume of work that would have taken half a week just two years ago. When you return from a satisfying meal, a coworker pings you on Slack:

Hey! How’s it going? I was just wondering what this block of code you merged this morning is doing. Time for a quick chat?
